Vláda neuvedla nový legislativní krok, pouze potvrdila pokračování v projektu iniciovaném dříve.
comment.en: By 2029, equip main corridors with ETCS system. The government program statement approved 5 January 2026 promises: 'Main corridors will be equipped by 2029 with the ETCS safety system.' ETCS rollout is already underway – since January 2025 exclusive operation is running on 622 km of tracks, in H1 2026 it should be introduced on the Prague–Czech Budějovice corridor. The government introduced no new legislative step, only confirming continuation of a project initiated earlier.

comment.en: Restore 75% discount on fares for students and seniors. The government program statement approved 5 January 2026 explicitly states: 'The cabinet also plans to restore discounts on fares for students and seniors at 75 percent.' This is a pure declaration without legislative action or government executive act. The Ministry of Transport presented an amendment proposal, but it has not yet been adopted by the Chamber of Deputies.

comment.cs: Odmítnout zákaz spalovacích motorů od 2035. Programové prohlášení vlády schválené 5.1.2026 obsahuje: 'Nastupující vláda odmítá zákaz spalovacích motorů od roku 2035.' Jedná se o čistou deklaraci postojů vlády bez jakéhokoli legislativního aktu. Česká republika nemá právní možnost unilaterálně odmítnout EU regulace – prohlášení je tedy čistě deklarativní bez faktického právního dopadu.
comment.en: Reject ban on combustion engines from 2035. The government program statement approved 5 January 2026 contains: 'The incoming government rejects the ban on combustion engines from 2035.' This is a pure declaration of government positions without any legislative action. The Czech Republic has no legal means to unilaterally reject EU regulations – the statement is therefore purely declarative without actual legal impact.

comment.en: Modernize Prague Airport including rail connection. The government program statement approved 5 January 2026 contains: 'We will support the Prague Airport modernization project, including rail connection from the city center.' The airport is conducting preparatory work – construction of cable ducts and transformer stations for over CZK 1 billion is underway (contractor selected November 2025, completion December 2026). The government supports the project budgetarily (CZK 26 billion increase for Transport Infrastructure Fund), but without specific new legislative or executive action after 15 December 2025, this is continuation of earlier preparations.

Minister Juchelka mentioned processing in one package during next year.

Fulfilment is thus only partial: yes for active domestic producers, but with conflict with the influence of large holdings.

Mobilní aplikace eDoklady již běží (660 000+ registrovaných uživatelů), ale jednotná digitální brána ve smyslu centrálního přístupu k webovým i mobilním službám s jednotným přihlášením není dosud plně zavedena.
comment.en: The Single Digital Gateway (SDG) is a European project managed by MPO and coordinated by DIA. The government approved a material in May 2026 clarifying the implementation approach. However, the process is long-term—it involves connecting eGovernment systems across the EU with an ambitious schedule. The eDoklady mobile app is already running (660,000+ registered users), but a unified digital gateway in the sense of centralized access to web and mobile services with unified login is not yet fully implemented.
